title: Narra 4.1.6
message: This release fixes Asian Drama detail loading and improves reliable Premium Drama playback.
changelog: Asian Drama details now load correctly instead of remaining on a loading screen.
Asian Drama players start loading only after the selected episode is requested.
Episode rows show source-provided episode names, with numbered fallbacks when a title is unavailable.
The Premium Home Drama focus keeps distinct Spotlight, Trending, Latest episodes, Most watched, Top rated, Coming soon and Animated stories rails.
